inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was found to be deficient. A caregiver admitted to not completing Face to Name Checks and a child was left unattended on the playground for around 2.5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Two classrooms had epi pens in lock med bags which were not locked. These bags were located inside a first aid bag in a rolling cart on the floor of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver who cares for children and has been employed for over 90 days needed the hands on CRP and First Aid training. One caregiver was missing CPR and First Aid training and has been employed for over 90 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was not attended to, and caregiver attending to other children and other chores instead of a child that required immediate attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was grabbed by the arms (extremities) to be moved to a different location. This may result in the child's arm being pulled from socket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined concrete evidence exists to support that the school have not followed the instructions on the sanitizing solution.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined there is concrete evidence to support the school was over ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: One staff that were present onsite during the visit were not shown to have background check in the system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: There were 3 infants cared for at the front office by the director. Director was caring for children at the front as there was no extra staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: There were 3 infants cared for at the front office by the director. Director was caring for children at the front to avoid being out of ratio in infant room. This is the third time occurrence during visits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Staff files did not have trainings available for review during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Staff files did not have trainings available for review during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Three out of five classrooms did not have the cots labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver had a total of 10 children in care. Five were ages 18M-23M and 5 were 2 years. Making the specified age group 18-23M.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of ten childrens files did not have updated immunizations available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The staff files were missing trainings as well as required docomentation that was not available during the visit. Nine files were reviewed and 5 out of 9 were missing abuse neglect training. 5 out of 9 were missing orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There was 6 infants cared for at the front office by 1 caregiver. There was 12 children ages 2 years old cared by 1 caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: The turf in the toddler playground was ripped under a play structure resulting in possible tripping or entanglement hazards.   7/31/24-The turf in the toddler playground was ripped under a play structure resulting in possible tripping or entanglement hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: There were 6 infants cared for at the front office by a caregiver and director. Director was caring for children while caregiver not present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver with conditions was left unsupervised in the 2 year old classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The recall form has not been updated since 1/3/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparness plan did not include the name and the address of the location where the school will evacuate away from the premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots in 4 classrooms were not labeled with names or numbers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: The turf in the toddler playground was ripped under a play structure resulting in possible tripping or entanglement hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was determined deficient. A caregiver served food to a child that was identified as food to which the child was allergic.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was determined to be deficient. A child registered for a Discovery Day did not have a completed food allergy plan while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and determined to be deficient. A child with a diagnosed food allergy, emergency food allergy plan was not posted in the kitchen and was not posted in the child's classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child not have a valid exemption affidavit in their file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The director nor Designee has not tested the smoke detectors at the operation for several months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One Child with a known food allergy did not have a Food Allergy Plan  in  their file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two children did not have updated immunizations in their files at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two Children did not have Food Allergy Plans in the their files at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The operation does not test their carbon monoxide detectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The director or designee has not tested the smoke detectors at the operation  for several months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Three caregivers did not have proof of education in their files at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current annual sanitation inspection report at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit for the school bus did not contain tweezers, cotton balls or a thermometer. The operation's first aid kit did not contain tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One teacher was observed supervising 21 children with a specified age group of 4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing an infants diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash an infant's hands after completing a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: The caregiver in Infant room I did not have required training to care for infants under the age of 24 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: Based on information gathered and observations, it was determined that a caregiver allowed children to wrestle, jump off of furniture, and run around a classroom. Putting children at risk for injuries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on information gathered through interviews and observations, it was determined that a child sustained an injury that required medical attention when a caregiver did not intervene when two children were running around in the classroom during a scheduled activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Attendance Records for all employees were not available in the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The person designated by the director did not have access to all essential information required by licensing during multiple inspections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials: The operation did not provide test data from the manufacturer showing the impact rating of the unitary surfacing materials nor the installation and maintenance requirements of the surfacing materials at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: A caregiver in the Toddler room I did not wash a child's hand after a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: The caregivers were not in proximity to intervene when the child broke his arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
